title: Unverified lead
description: One unverified/<slug>.yaml file (#660): an offer the offer-hunter found on X, Reddit, or the web but could not confirm on an official page. Leads are never offers and never reach index.json, the llms files, or offer pages. A lead is listed only while its newest dated source post is at most fresh_days (3) days old; a lead with no dated source is invalid. scripts/lead_model.py and app/scripts/load-leads.mjs enforce this schema plus the shared rules in schemas/unverified-lead.rules.json: action-shaped unsafe wording (DMs; sending keys or secrets; adding card or payment details; connecting a wallet; third-party forms; joining a Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp group), NFKC-normalised, no registrable domain other than the provider's own in any text field, plain https URLs only (no userinfo, port or backslash), no link shorteners or forms. scripts/validate_offers.py cross-checks the enums against this schema.

slug.description: Equals the file name without .yaml; never the slug of an offer.

claim.description: What is claimed, as posted, short. No links and no domain other than the provider's own.

sources.description: At least one source must carry a date; the lead is listed until the newest date + 3 days.

first_seen.description: First day the hunt spotted the lead (shown as 'First spotted by our hunt').

last_seen.description: Last day the hunt checked the lead (shown as 'Last checked'). Never extends freshness.
